name: ab logo
code:
; The AB monogram. An "a" and a "b" that are the same shape turned half way
; round: a ring with a gap, and a stem that drops (a) or rises (b) from it.
; Measurements are the logo's own, on a 100 x 100 grid, times :k.
make "k 2.4
make "ro 24.57 * :k           ; outer radius of the ring (and the stem's length)
make "ri 15.18 * :k           ; inner radius
make "cutx 13.96 * :k         ; where the ring ends, just short of the stem

; A point on the letter. :s is 1 for the "a" and -1 for the "b".
to pt :cx :s :dx :dy
  setxy :cx + :s * :dx :s * :dy
end

; An arc of the ring at radius :r from angle :a0 to :a1, in degrees.
to arcpts :cx :s :r :a0 :a1
  for [i 0 72] [
    make "t :a0 + (:a1 - :a0) * :i / 72
    pt :cx :s :r * cos :t :r * sin :t
  ]
end

to piece :cx :s
  localmake "outerend 360 - arccos (:cutx / :ro)
  localmake "innerend 360 - arccos (:cutx / :ri)
  pu
  pt :cx :s :ri 0                      ; start at the top of the stem, inner edge
  filled 0 [
    pt :cx :s :ri (0 - :ro)            ; down the stem
    pt :cx :s :ro (0 - :ro)
    pt :cx :s :ro 0
    arcpts :cx :s :ro 0 :outerend      ; round the outside
    arcpts :cx :s :ri :innerend 0      ; and back round the inside
  ]
end

fitwindow 290            ; so the whole logo fits whatever the window size
cs ht setbg 7 setpc 0
piece (0 - 25.43 * :k) 1
piece 25.43 * :k (0 - 1)

name: flower
code:
; Twelve squares rotated into a flower
to square :s
  repeat 4 [fd :s rt 90]
end
to flower
  repeat 12 [square 25 rt 30]
end
cs setpc 4 flower

name: koch
code:
; Koch snowflake
to koch :len :depth
  if :depth = 0 [fd :len stop]
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1 lt 60
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1 rt 120
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1 lt 60
  koch :len / 3 :depth - 1
end
to snowflake :len :depth
  repeat 3 [koch :len :depth rt 120]
end
cs pu setxy -30 15 pd setpc 3 snowflake 60 3

name: spiral
code:
; Tail-recursive spiral that stops at the edge of the screen
to spiral :s
  if :s > 35 [stop]
  fd :s rt 91
  spiral :s + 1
end
cs setpc 6 spiral 1

name: stars
code:
; Lists, templates and colour
to star :n
  repeat 5 [fd :n rt 144]
end
foreach [1 2 4 5 6 9 12 14] [
  setpc ?
  pu setxy (-50 + 12 * repcount) (10 * sin 40 * repcount) pd
  star 10
]

name: stencil demo
code:
; A stencil to print: block letters "OK" over a star.
; Pen size is the slot width in mm (1 step = 1 mm). Run:
;   termlogo examples/stencil_demo.logo -o demo.stl
; Islands (the middle of the O and the star) are bridged automatically.

to letter.o
  pu setxy 0 0 pd setheading 0
  repeat 2 [fd 40 rt 90 fd 28 rt 90]
end
to letter.k
  pu setxy 40 0 pd setheading 0 fd 40
  pu setxy 40 20 pd setheading 45 fd 28
  pu setxy 40 20 pd setheading 135 fd 28
end
to star :s repeat 5 [fd :s rt 144] end
cs setpensize 3 setpc 7
letter.o letter.k
setpensize 1.6
pu setxy 6 -48 pd seth 72 star 46

name: stencil fill
code:
; A stencil with cut-out areas: a filled window, and two FILLED shapes. Run:
;   termlogo examples/stencil_fill.logo -o fill.stl
; FILL cuts out the area enclosed by the lines already drawn. The small square
; inside the window is left as an island and is bridged automatically.
; FILLED cuts out the shape the turtle traces, with the pen up or down.

cs setpensize 2
repeat 4 [fd 30 rt 90]
pu setxy 10 10 pd repeat 4 [fd 10 rt 90]
pu setxy 5 5 pd setpc 2 fill
setpc 4 pu setxy 45 0 pd filled 6 [repeat 3 [fd 30 rt 120]]
pu setxy -40 0 filled 1 [repeat 36 [fd 3 rt 10]]
ht

name: tree
code:
; Recursive binary tree
to tree :size
  if :size < 3 [stop]
  fd :size
  lt 25 tree :size * 0.7
  rt 50 tree :size * 0.7
  lt 25
  bk :size
end
cs pu bk 30 pd setpc 2 tree 28
